column3: Kirino Route · For My Little Sister To Ignore Me Isn't...Is Possible
I'm home.
Hey, I have something I want you to listen to...
Hey, don't ignore me.
What? Didn't I tell the pervert not to talk to me?
You're the one that asked for a life-counseling session, though.
Huh? I don't expect anything from you at this point.
...Oh really?  However, I don't intend to give up halfway.
Anyway, let's not talk about such topics here. Mom will hear us.
...I get it. Then your room should be fine?
Tch, you do know what the consequences are if you do anything strange, right?
Hmph. So, what do you want me to listen to?
Ahh, if you listen to this, your memories should return... I think.
...It isn't some strange sounds you recorded, is it?
As if I'd do that. Besides, what do you mean by strange sounds?
You're asking me that? ...That's why you're a pervert.
...What are you imagining, you little...
What? Turn it on so I can listen already.
No.... that is....
Hurry up.
....Don't be so snappy.
It's impossible. Even if I make the current Kirino listen to that denpa song, she'll just get angry at me again like yesterday.
Seeing how my little sister has become like this, I start to think again.
In this whole year, the relationship between my sister and I... has definitely changed a lot.
...It's in this music player.
I won't go easy on you if you make me listen to some strange things.
Settle down. You won't die even if you listen to it for a bit.
All right, I pressed play.
...I absolutely can't listen to this!
That's too fast! It's still at the introduction, isn't it?
Listening to this for 5 seconds will rot away my brain. What's with this strange song?
It's a song you composed, though!
